summary: The ErrorOccurred module presents a localized error page that displays custom error messages and provides contact information to users. It adapts the UI based on locale (English/French), fetches contact email from configuration, and renders error messages based on the context (general error or validation error).
purpose: To inform users of application errors, provide appropriately localized UI and messaging, and direct users to contact support with a configurable email address. It distinguishes between general and HTTP validation errors, and shows different content based on locale.

fields.name: ErrorEmail
fields.description: Contact email displayed in error messages; customizable via web.config.

fields.name: Locale
fields.description: Determines UI language and content (English or French).

fields.name: subject
fields.description: Database name appended to error messages.

fields.name: HttpRequestValidationException
fields.description: Determines if a validation error occurred, changing the error message.

actors: System (ASP.NET application handling error and localization)

workflows.name: Display Localized Error Page
steps: Page_Load executed on error page request.
Determine locale from query string; if 'en-US' or empty, select English UI.
Show HeaderEN or HeaderFR based on locale.
Fetch ErrorEmail from web.config depending on locale.
Check if HttpRequestValidationException parameter is '1'; if so, show specific validation error message.
Render localized error message in uxErrorMessage.
InitializeCulture method sets UI/Culture threads based on locale.

business_rules: ErrorEmail must be customizable per instance via web.config.
Locale determines which header panel and error message to display.
validations: Locale must be a valid culture string (e.g., 'en-US', 'fr-CA').
HttpRequestValidationException must be '1' to trigger validation error message.
conditions: Show HeaderEN if usingDefaultLocale; HeaderFR otherwise.
Use ERROR_EMAIL for English, ERROR_EMAIL_ALT for French.
system_behavior: Page loads and adapts UI based on locale.
Fetches configuration values for contact information and database name.
Renders error message dynamically based on error context.
Culture and UI threads initialized based on user locale.
content_gaps: No sample error messages or full localized resource strings found.
No specific guidance on error logging or reporting exceptions beyond UI display.
Underlying error causes and remediation steps not described.
